palette.notes: Frames: shop in warm orange-red wood with cream floors; dungeon in saturated teal; night village in deep blue with yellow lamp pools. Each place owns one colour family.

lighting: Warm interior lamp light in the shop; at night the village is blue and lamps throw round warm pools on the ground (clip 3, 39-44 s). Contrast of warm pools on a cool ground.
silhouette: Small top-down sprites with big heads; hero Will (wiki) and customers read by hair and hat shapes. Thought bubbles with prices or faces float above customers.

motion.timing: No frame timings measured. Shop scene: customers walk to a table, stop, a bubble pops up with their reaction, then they walk to the counter or leave.

texture: Clean tiles with soft 2-3 step shading on wood, stone and grass; detailed furniture props around an open floor.
camera: Fixed top-down, one room per screen; the shop is framed as a stage with the counter at the bottom. Day shop / night dungeon loop (wiki).

acting.enters: Customers come in through the door one by one and walk to a pedestal.
acting.acts: Each customer stops at an item and shows a reaction bubble (happy, neutral, angry about price), then buys or walks away.
acting.exits: Satisfied customers walk to the counter; others walk out; the next comes in.
acting.depth: All on one plane; scale comes from the wide room. Moonlighter 2 (3D, not pixel) uses the same shop staging.

techniques: reaction bubble above the head instead of facial animation
repeated loop: enter, look, react, leave, next one
warm lamp pools on a cool night ground
one colour family per place (orange shop, teal dungeon, blue night)
room as a stage with a fixed counter
feel: warm wood shop + small top-down customers + pop-up reaction bubbles + enter/react/leave loop = cozy readable routine
for_fred: Use Moonlighter's customer loop for Fred: he swims in, looks at the thing, a small pixel bubble pops above him (heart, '?', '!'), he leaves; later he comes back and the bubble changes. Repeat 2-3 times with one change each time.
